summaryZh: Kwon 实验室开发脑部疾病的工具、诊断与治疗方案，聚焦纳米尺度生物启发材料。团队设计可报告创伤性脑损伤中 calpain 活性的纳米传感器，并开发向受损脑组织递送蛋白和核酸的靶向纳米载体。
researchQuestions: 如何利用纳米材料检测和治疗脑部疾病？
methods: 生物启发纳米材料设计

evidence.quote: The Kwon Lab in the Bioengineering Department at UC San Diego engineers tools, diagnostics, and treatments for disorders that affect the brain.
We build nanosensors that respond to disease-associated activity of the protease calpain in traumatic brain injury to image calpain activity in the living brain.
we develop targeted nanocarriers that deliver therapeutic macromolecules such as proteins and nucleic acids to the injured brain.
